Tom Holland's watch collection: Cartier Tank Américaine WGTA0134, Patek Philippe Aquanaut 5167R-001 and Rolex Cosmograph Daytona 126506.

Outlook India names six watches in his collection (19 August 2026). Prices are US retail, checked 25 November 2026: $20,300 (Cartier), $53,514 (Patek Philippe), $84,600 (Rolex). Ownership is the outlet's claim.
